quest.title: Glimmers of the Vigilant Yaksha
quest.description: As payment to attain Starsnatcher's help, you prepare to go to Wanwen Bookhouse to purchase books about cooking. Upon arriving at the bookstore, you find...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: So you'd like a copy of "Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti"?

dialogues.speaker: Starsnatcher
dialogues.text: Yes. Here, and keep the change.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Oh, aren't you generous? Thank you for your patronage!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, isn't that, um... Starsnapper? What a coincidence, running into him again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did you hear the name of that book he just bought? Was it... "Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh, well anyway, it was definitely a book about the adepti. Why would an adeptus wanna buy a book about himself?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? What's so fishy about him?

choices.text: Why would an adeptus want people to pay him Mora?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, that's a good point... None of the other adepti we've met seemed like they needed anything from anyone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks we should check out that book. Maybe we'll find out something about this guy that we can use!

choices.text: He's a charlatan, if you ask me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So what you're trying to say is that he can't grant people's wishes?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true, it really is. Very suspicious...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Could be!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, but now that Paimon thinks about it, there's something that's just not right about this guy.

choices.text: Why would an adeptus want people to pay him Mora?
He's a charlatan, if you ask me.

talks.objective: Talk to Jifang and ask about Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there. We'd like a copy of "Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti" — do you have one in stock?

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Huh. Since when did that old chestnut become a best-seller?

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: You're a rare breed of youngster if this is what you like to read... But you should be able to find a copy somewhere on that desk over there.

talks.objective: Search for Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is the one! Let's see what it's about, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Finished yet? Hehe, Paimon's already done.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This book is about the yakshas, a group of adepti who defend Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing else that I can think of...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup, Paimon thinks we've already summed up all the key points.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, back to the matter at hand. The things we need answers on are one, where did those super evil-looking hilichurls come from, and two, what does Starsnatcher have to do with the yakshas. Right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now to head back to where this all started and commence our investigation! Let's part the fog of mystery that hangs over Jueyun Karst, and let the truth shine through in its full glory!

choices.text: So we're playing detective now, are we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ehehe! To be honest, Paimon actually hopes he is a real adeptus. Ah... His exorcism techniques seemed real enough, at least...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, but if we get our hopes up, there's further for them to come down. So it makes sense to investigate thoroughly first, just to be sure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, let's head back to Wangshu Inn!

talks.objective: Return to Wangshu Inn and look for Starsnatcher

dialogues.speaker: Starsnatcher
dialogues.text: Flee at my command, foul demons!

dialogues.speaker: Starsnatcher
dialogues.text: ...Flee!

dialogues.speaker: Starsnatcher
dialogues.text: Wh—Why won't you flee?!

dialogues.speaker: Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Beru nye! Beru nya! Beru nyaaaa!!!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-oh, looks like Starsnatcher's in trouble!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And there are innocent bystanders here, too. We have to step in!

talks.objective: Defeat the hilichurls with the evil aura
Talk to Starsnatcher and find out what happened

dialogues.speaker: Starsnatcher
dialogues.text: I don't get it... Why didn't the Sigil of Permission do anything?

dialogues.speaker: Starsnatcher
dialogues.text: Has the evil aura of these hilichurls grown in intensity?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sigil of Permission, huh? Now why does that sound familiar?

choices.text: Ah yes, the get out of Jueyun free card...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right! It's a keepsake of the adepti, so it must still contain traces of their power!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *gasp* No wonder he was able to scare those monsters away earlier...

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: Wh—What are you two babbling on about? One is merely underslept... meaning that one's adeptal power... is not in full flow!

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: Were one but given another opportunity...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well as it happens, there goes another bunch of evil hilichurls over there. Should we leave them to you, then?

response.speaker: Starsnatcher
response.text: I— O—One... suddenly feels ill at ease. Surely one has overexpended one's adeptal powers, otherwise, one would surely purge these infernal beings at once...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, so you WERE just bragging after all. We were right to be suspicious!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, Traveler, looks like it's up to us. Use your Elemental Sight and hunt them down!

choices.text: So that's what he was using for his exorcisms...

dialogues.speaker: Male Believer
dialogues.text: I still have some valuables at home, Starsnatcher. I can bring them tomorrow, to see if they're to your liking.

dialogues.speaker: Female Believer
dialogues.text: I'm only at ease with the Master of Stars present...

dialogues.speaker: Mercantile Believer
dialogues.text: Please Starsnatcher, watch over me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, seems like a pretty niche topic. Was there anything that stood out to you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About demons...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The book says that the wrathful spirits of the gods defeated during the Archon War can sometimes cause plagues, monsters or mutations...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All of which sound pretty horrendous. Hey, wait a second... Paimon wonders if...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you think those super-evil hilichurls we saw earlier were the "mutations" that the book's talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About karma...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The book says that the yakshas, after fighting against the wrath of the gods for thousands of years, became bound by karma.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Poisoned by the hateful thoughts of the gods, the yakshas would often descend into indescribable fits of terror, rage, or agony...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's so tragic... After everything they went through in all their years of protecting Liyue, they got no reward, and had to deal with so much suffering instead.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the sole surviving yaksha...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, there used to be five main yakshas, but supposedly only one of them is still alive today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you think that it could have anything to do with that Starsnatcher guy?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hm... No, surely not. He doesn't exactly give off the impression that he's been suffering for thousands of years...

dialogues.speaker: Starsnatcher
dialogues.text: You need not fret — as long as you evidence your faith, your wishes will be granted.
